title: Machine learning identifies PPARG as a diagnostic biomarker for sepsis linked to CD14/NF-κB signaling: integrated transcriptomics and experimental validation.
summary: Transcriptomic machine-learning analysis identified PPARG as a candidate diagnostic biomarker for sepsis; the study reports experimental follow-up of the candidate and its CD14/NF-κB signaling context. This does not establish clinical diagnostic utility.
ai_technology: Machine-learning transcriptomic analysis identifies PPARG as a sepsis biomarker candidate for experimental follow-up.
organization: Department of Critical Care Medicine, The First Affiliated Hospital of Soochow University, Suzhou, China

evidence.tested: Experimental follow-up was reported, but clinical diagnostic utility and prospective performance were not established.
evidence.unknown: External replication and real-world or clinical benefit were not established by the reviewed study
evidence.ai_role: Machine-learning transcriptomic analysis identifies PPARG as a sepsis biomarker candidate for experimental follow-up.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
